## 4. Results

Table 3 reports the difference-in-differences estimates of the rule's effect on quoted spreads, and Figure 2 plots the same estimate by event month.

Table 3: DiD estimates of the effect on quoted spreads

| | Coef. | Std. err. | t-stat |
|---|---|---|---|
| Treat × Post | -0.42 | 0.11 | -3.82 |
| Post | 0.05 | 0.07 | 0.71 |

![Figure 2: Event-study coefficients on quoted spreads, with 95% intervals](figures/event_study_spreads.png)

Spreads fall by 0.42 basis points for treated stocks after the rule takes effect.
